svg.title: Booking a visit in the original Spring PetClinic
svg.desc: GET loads the owner, selects the pet and prepares a new visit dated tomorrow before showing the form. A separate POST prepares again and binds and validates the form input. If a date is present after binding, it must be in the future. Errors return the form without an explicit save. Valid input is associated and saved, then redirected. The error and success paths are alternatives.

g.text: Booking a visit in the original Spring PetClinic
GET loads Owner, selects its Pet, creates and attaches a Visit in memory
Render the form without an explicit repository save
POST prepares the model again and binds and validates input
If the bound date is present, check that it is in the future
No explicit repository save in this branch
Cascading follows Owner to Pet to Visit
A subsequent request loads the page
User submits a separate HTTP request
Arrows show the order in which VisitController handles the two requests.
Own diagram of the pinned source code. The error and success branches are alternatives.
